## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_劫财 (Fire carrying The Rival). Persona The Rival (劫财). Definition line: "Same nature, different register, the edge of comparison". Keyword Rivalry, charge fierce, poles catalyst Daring / friction Drain. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: comparison as fuel; the race never announces a finish. Arena: the race, the shared prize, the other runner. Classical portrait: same nature, different register; comparison as fuel; the race with no announced finish. Ruled domains: Rivalry, Shared stakes, Boldness. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 比肩.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Fire. structural_interaction seed: "Warmth meeting warmth cross-polarity — presence competing with presence".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the Rival: flame that leaps between torches. You catch ambition from the people around you and pass yours back doubled, the most contagious energy in any gathering. Stakes make you luminous. The same draft that spreads your fire can spread it thin, so choose which blazes are actually yours."
- k2_functional: "Your energy flares with company and stakes, then needs true dark to recover."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Hot-headed","Resentful","Explosive"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Rivalry":"Your rivals are accelerants: nothing focuses your flame like a nearby blaze. Keep rivalry ritual, races and games and friendly scoreboards, so the heat builds camaraderie instead of ash.","Shared stakes":"You fund and join easily, splitting bills and risks in the same warm gesture. Enthusiasm signs faster than judgment reads. Let every shared blaze get one cold morning review before you pour fuel.","Boldness":"Your boldness ignites others, which multiplies its consequences. Lead the charges worth leading. A spark that picks its tinder builds bonfires. One that does not builds regrets."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]

- Sibling cell 火_比肩 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Self-lit","Vivid","Undimmed"],"friction":["Too proud","Touchy","Unapproachable"]}
- Sibling cell 火_比肩 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your fire needs no external ignition. Motivation, celebration, recovery: all generated onboard, on your schedule, from your own fuel. Gray seasons that dim everyone else find your output unchanged, and people eventually ask where the switch is. There is no switch. There is just you, on."

Core element Fire, energy element Fire. Law: Fire and Fire are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Fire is this core's Body. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Fire core that shows Fire on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Fire as the Body is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 火_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You rise to a dare before deciding if you want it. You wake in a contest like nowhere else, so you weigh the rival ahead of the stakes. Skip a race sometimes, because rising to everything means running some that were never yours.

value_b.text: You are ready for a challenge before anyone explains it. You feel more alive in a test than after a win, so you rise to the next rather than ask what it pays. Give your best to whoever dares you, and some to whoever asks.

value.text: You give a friend's dare your full speed before they take it back. Winning in front of a friend matters more than keeping it friendly, so you play every round for keeps. Throw a round once, since what they lose with you is the fun.

value.text: Other people's ambition is the kind you catch fastest. You catch a rival's goal faster than you find your own, so you run on borrowed wanting rather than wait. Keep one goal nobody handed you, since half of what you chase began as somebody else's.

value_b.text: You catch ambition instead of growing it alone. You wake up fast to someone else's hunger, and you would rather run beside a driven person than sit with a plan. Sit with your own plan once, because you catch the pace of whoever is nearest.

value.text: Catching ambition is quicker than growing it, and you know it. You go after what a rival chases ahead of asking what you want yourself, because wanting alone feels thin. Ask yourself anyway, since the chance nobody else runs for is yours to lose.

value.text: On a shared bet, you go all in before anyone asks. Holding back feels like not being there, so you put in your money ahead of reading the terms. Read the terms once, since all in makes you first to pay and last to know.

value_b.text: Going all in is your only speed on a shared bet. You would rather match the boldest person there than hold back part, since part feels like half a friendship. Put in half for once, because you are generous first and careful second.
